description: This file contains deprecated methods and utility functions for the jQuery library, including extensions to the jQuery prototype, function binding, and type checking utilities.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Attaches an event handler to elements for the specified event types, using jQuery's on method.

methods.name: unbind
methods.description: Removes event handlers for the specified event types, using jQuery's off method.

methods.name: delegate
methods.description: Attaches a delegated event handler for specified selector and event types.

methods.name: undelegate
methods.description: Removes delegated event handlers for a specific selector and event types.

methods.name: proxy()
methods.description: Creates a proxy function that will always have a particular context and optionally partially applies arguments.

methods.name: holdReady( hold )
methods.description: Increments or decrements the jQuery ready counter or executes jQuery.ready when counter is zero.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if the provided object is an Array.

methods.name: parseJSON
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JavaScript object.

methods.name: nodeName
methods.description: Checks the nodeName of a DOM element.

methods.name: isFunction
methods.description: Determines if the object is a function.

methods.name: isWindow
methods.description: Checks if the object is a window object.

methods.name: camelCase
methods.description: Converts a string to camel case.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the object as a string.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp.

methods.name: isNumeric( obj )
methods.description: Determines if the object is a numeric value or string that can be coerced to a number.
